## Summary

What changes, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation or accessibility
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] PK model, assumptions, or numerical behavior
- [ ] Data exchange / R interoperability
- [ ] Security / dependency update

## Verification

- [ ] `node --test tests/*.test.cjs` passes
- [ ] Changed JavaScript passes `node --check`
- [ ] Tested relevant desktop/mobile behavior or explained why not
- [ ] Explained units, input validation, and edge cases
- [ ] Updated references or documentation where needed
- [ ] No patient-identifying data, secrets, or unlicensed assets

## Scientific impact (if applicable)

Explain equations or parameter changes, primary-source support, uncertainty, validation limits, and whether comparison graphs or exported data change.

## Screenshots / example CSV (if applicable)

Use synthetic data only.

**Reminder:** AyFlux is educational software, not clinical decision support. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
